datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Madagascar to estimate acutely food insecure populations under different scenarios. The resulting population impact estimates represent direct consequences of food insecurity conditions, primarily driven by drought and other hazards affecting food availability and access.
